time_basis: Review date America/New_York; network retrieval timestamps UTC.

comparison_method.normalization: Strict UTF-8 decoding; remove script/style/noscript/template descendants; get_text separator space, strip=True; collapse Unicode whitespace via split/join; SHA-256 of UTF-8 text. Article can include duplicate contents lists and related cards; these are retained. Table/heading/annotation/caption/alt ordered lists independently hashed as JSON with ensure_ascii=False, compact separators. No case folding or punctuation/number removal.
comparison_method.byte_comparison: Mask only four enumerated Wayback-generated fields: analytics server/timing, replay retrieval date, appended playback timings comment, toolbar capture count. Compare every remaining byte.
comparison_method.excluded: Linked image/script/CSS bytes, script-rendered content, external documents and linked incident PDF; article text and image alt/captions included. No independent human coding or experimental verification.
